title: HSE-01 Health, safety and environment
summary: Cost centre HSE-01 covers Health, safety and environment in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner HWEBER, with £93,602.59 available in 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre HSE-01 covers Health, safety and environment operations within operating unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner HWEBER [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre is open and holds £93,602.59 in available budget for 2026-Q4 against a total quarterly allocation of £143,000 [^r1][^r2].

| Cost centre | Name | Unit | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HSE-01 | Health, safety and environment | NBC-MAN-01 | HWEBER | OPEN |

## Budget and spend

Budget and spend records for cost centre HSE-01 are tracked in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2]. For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, HSE-01 has an allocated budget of £143,000, committed spend of £49,397.41, and an available balance of £93,602.59 [^r2].

| Period | Budget amount | Committed spend | Available budget | As of |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-Q4 | £143,000 | £49,397.41 | £93,602.59 | 26 October 2026 09:00 |
